audit_items.proof_trace: deposit_ctoken unconditionally calls is_supporting_collateral before join_ctoken; if the entry does not exist, support_collateral_token initializes all three tracking structures (coin_types, balances, ctoken_values) atomically. join_ctoken itself asserts coin_types.supports<CoinType>() as a redundant guard, making it impossible to add balance without a prior initialized entry. The only package-scoped caller (handle_mint) always routes through deposit_ctoken.
